sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an excellent run of five consecutive wins, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in dire form, having lost their last five matches, making this a favorable fixture for Sandbach to extend their unbeaten streak.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a contest between sides occupying 3rd and 5th respectively. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, welcome Wednesfield Community at home. Elsewhere, in-form Bilston Town (6th, on a recent run) travel to Foley Meir, and Barnton host Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table and struggling sides. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash between sides occupying 8th and 10th, while Crewe face Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social welcome struggling Widnes Town (bottom with just 2 points and no wins all season). Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a contest between two of the division's lowest-placed sides.
